notes.title: UPDATE AND SALE
notes.content:
During the year I tried to listen to the players and make changes in time. Sorry if there were delays and I missed something. This is the latest update this year.

Next year you will find many new good games! In the meantime, you can purchase Spaceship Looter with a 70% discount!

UPDATE:

- Minor bugs fixed

tags.bug: - Minor bugs fixed

notes.title: VERY IMPORTANT UPDATE
notes.content:
I get a lot of complaints from the players that you can not dodge bullets when you're in the corner. To whom this creates fun, and someone is experiencing difficulty. In order for the enemies and the player to have equal rights, I added evasion during the jump. Now if the player is in a jump, then the bullets bounce off him.

I hope you appreciate this important update and if necessary, change the review about the game. Thank you!

notes.content:

Soon I'll add full support for the PS4 gamepad.

Thank you for reporting errors!

Have fan!

notes.title: UPDATE 10
notes.content:
- Resurrection now costs 50 crystals. Freebie has ended =)
- Added control for lefties. I'm sorry that I did not do it right away. If something seems uncomfortable, tell me.
[code]
I, J, K, L - motion
U - action / cast
P - map
O - active item
Y - recharge
SPACE - jump
[/code]

Thank you for not forgetting to write positive reviews!

notes.title: FULL RELEASE IS AVAILABLE!
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27973960/eb441f8add7e2a483e9924d311fc7e6f33465e66.png[/img]

Today is a significant day! After almost a month, Spaceship Looter goes into full release!

Thanks to everyone who supported the game in early access and helped make it better! I tried to take into account almost all of your comments.

What to expect from the game next? The work on a new project is starting, but Spaceship Looter will continue to be supported. New languages will be added and possible mistakes will be corrected.

I'm sure the game will bring you a lot of fun!


[h1]UPDATE 9 (last in early access)[/h1]
[b]Major[/b]
[List]
[*] Trolleys are replaced with dangerous saws.
[*] Increased damage to all weapons.
[*] Increased HP of bosses.
[*] The shield of the scientist blinks before disappearing.
[*] Resurrection now only works on easy complexity.
[*] Achievements have been translated into Russian.
[/List]

tags.balance_change: [*] Increased damage to all weapons.
[*] Increased HP of bosses.

tags.feature: [*] Achievements have been translated into Russian.

notes.title: UPDATE 8
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27973960/855721cc9cee19c395958e946d7d9c75edc7b755.png[/img]

[B]Major[/ b]
[List]
[*] Inside the rooms now there are not destructible walls.
[*] Now the map needs to be investigated.
[*] The enhancement terminal is now displayed on the map.
[*] In the additional menu appeared button to exit the game.
[*] After passing the training the player appears near the teleport.
[*] Added the ending in the form of thanks from the boss of the pub.
[*] Changed the weapon description in the map menu.
[*] New Arena mode, which opens after collecting all collector's artifacts.
[*] Leaderboards in arena mode.
[*] The weapons in the store can be seen right away and the old one does not disappear.
[*] All skills now consume energy.
[*] On a pirate frigate now can not be resurrected.
[*] New GUI
[*] New system for pumping a hero's skill.
[/ List]

[B]Bug Fixes[/ b]
[List]
[*] The frame in the hero selection menu no longer overlaps the medal.
[*] On some computers, the game worked at a speed of 120 fps (fixed, but there is no way to check).
[*] Active ability "Circular Shot" on the laser now works correctly.
[*] Shells falling from above, did damage even if the hero had invulnerability.
[*] Shells falling from above, did damage even if the hero was standing in a protective field.
[*] Mimic, sometimes hooked on the walls
[*] In the pause menu, you could recharge weapons, use skills and open a card.
[*] The enemies now do not fire when the pause is turned on or you are killed.
[*] When freezing the pirates froze only a cannon.
[*] Fixed some sounds.
[*] Sometimes there was an error in the main menu.
[/ List]

Friends, thank you for your patience! I spent 2 weeks working on this update and the new Arena regime. I hope you will enjoy!

notes.title: UPDATE 6 AND BONUS
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27973960/3441e8f08729ce3989940bd0c7ae91b8740db838.gif[/img]

[b]Major[/b]
[list]
[*] Selecting the difficulty mode.
[*] 2 NEW passive items.
[*] 8 NEW active items.
[*] Of pirates falls less crystals.
[*] Sound of the jump.
[*] Items in the store now have a signature.
[*] Adjusting the volume of music and sounds.
[*] When the game is minimized, music and sounds are turned off.
[*] Achievement for passing the game can only be taken on the easy difficulty.
[*] If you collect all the collector's items, then he will give a special weapon.
[/list]

[b]Bug Fixes[/b]
[list]
[*] The turret gave + 5 ammo each shot
[*] The laser sometimes missed enemies
[*] Teleport particles sometimes flew under the walls
[*] Friser correctly acts on bosses
[*] The key to the box could bounce off the wall
[*] The text of the training is now suitable for any character
[/list]

Friends, thank you for interesting ideas for the game and help in fixing problems. I hope for your support in the future!

[b]BONUS[/b]
If you pass the game demo on easy difficulty, you will receive the key to the full version. The main thing to be first!

DEMO: http://gamejolt.com/games/spaceship_looter/246064 

Good luck!
